title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Lead AI/ML Engineer About the Role We're looking for a hands-on Lead AI/ML Engineer to help transform our SaaS platform into an intelligent, data-driven product. This role goes beyond adding AI features. You'll identify where AI, machine learning and automation can create genuine commercial value, then design, build and deliver solutions that improve customer workflows, decision-making and operational efficiency. Working closely with the Founder, Product and Engineering teams, you'll define our AI roadmap, shape our data architecture and build scalable AI capabilities that become core to the platform. As the business grows, you'll have the opportunity to lead our AI function. What You'll Do Understand our SaaS platform, customer workflows and business goals. Identify high-impact AI and automation opportunities. Design and build AI-powered product features using Python and modern AI frameworks. Develop predictive models, recommendation engines and intelligent workflow automation. Build LLM-powered features using OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic or similar technologies. Design RAG solutions, vector search and AI orchestration where appropriate. Improve data architecture, APIs and pipelines to support AI at scale. Deploy, monitor and maintain production AI/ML systems. Implement AI governance, explainability and security best practices. Work with engineering teams to integrate AI into the core product. Help shape the company's long-term AI strategy and future AI team. Required Skills Strong commercial experience in AI/ML Engineering, Software Engineering or Data Engineering. Excellent Python development skills. Experience building AI features into production SaaS products. Machine learning model development and deployment. Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases and RAG. Strong SQL, database design and data modelling experience. REST APIs and system integrations. Cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS. Ability to translate business problems into practical AI solutions. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Nice to Have SaaS product experience. LangChain, LlamaIndex or Semantic Kernel. Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant or Azure AI Search. MLOps, model monitoring and CI/CD. Workflow automation or operational systems. Multi-agent AI. Analytics platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks or Microsoft Fabric. What Success Looks Like You'll quickly understand our platform, identify the highest-value AI opportunities and deliver intelligent features that: Improve customer decision-making. Automate manual processes. Generate predictive insights. Optimise workflows. Turn platform data into a long-term commercial asset. Why Join Us? Shape the AI strategy of an established SaaS platform. Build meaningful AI solutions—not superficial AI add-ons. Work directly with senior leadership. Influence product strategy, data architecture and automation. Opportunity to grow into Head of AI / AI Engineering Leadership. If you're passionate about building production AI systems that deliver measurable business value and want to play a key role in shaping the future of an ambitious SaaS business, we'd love to hear from you.
